scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @nk/shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web "npm run dev --workspace @nk/api" "npm run dev --workspace @nk/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @nk/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @nk/shared && npm run build --workspace @nk/api && npm run build --workspace @nk/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @nk/shared && npm run test --workspace @nk/shared && npm run test --workspace @nk/api && npm run test --workspace @nk/web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build --workspace @nk/shared && node scripts/test-integration.mjs e2e
